metadata.name: Fermod Kit 5010 Fault Code Knowledge Pack v1.0

equipment_characteristics.operating_temperature: -30°C to +45°C, with low-temperature option requirement below -10°C

metadata.design_intent: Offline-first door controller code assistant: decode display code, guide technician checks, record results, and sync when online.
metadata.safety_statement: This knowledge pack is a diagnostic aid. Electrical work, motor disconnection, safety device testing, and live measurements must be performed only by qualified personnel following local regulations and company SOP.

process: Remove non-digit characters only if used as separators
If integer is 0, return special code 0000
Otherwise decompose using known additive flags [256,32,16,8,4,2,1]
If any remainder remains, mark as unknown/unsupported code

parser_spec.triage_rationale_zh: 消防、急停/鎖、安全裝置、馬達阻塞與位置丟失優先於一般摩擦或資訊狀態。

fault_codes.summary_zh: 控制器偵測到一個開門輸入信號正在啟動。通常代表按鈕、拉繩、雷達、磁環或其他開門信號仍處於啟動狀態。
possible_causes: 開門按鈕卡住或接點保持閉合
拉繩、雷達、磁環或遙控輸入保持啟動
開門信號線路短路或接線錯誤
使用了保持型接點，而不是 manual 要求的 impulse 型開門信號

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 確認門附近是否有人正在按住開門按鈕、拉繩或其他開門裝置。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Check whether someone is holding the open button, pull cord, or another opening device.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 檢查開門按鈕是否卡住，拉繩或雷達是否持續輸出信號。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Inspect whether the open button is stuck or the pull cord/radar is continuously sending an open signal.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 進入 input/output display，檢查 opening input 狀態是否為 ON。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Enter the input/output display and check whether the opening input is ON.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 若懷疑接線問題，由合資格人員使用萬用錶檢查開門輸入端子是否持續閉合。
guided_checks.instruction_en: If wiring is suspected, qualified personnel should use a multimeter to check whether the opening input terminal remains closed.

recommended_resolution: 解除卡住的開門裝置
修復或更換故障按鈕 / 拉繩 / 雷達
確認所有開門命令為 impulse model，避免保持閉合造成門一直保持開啟

fault_codes.title_zh: 急停 / 停止命令或鎖接點啟動
fault_codes.title_en: Stop command active or lock active
fault_codes.manual_meaning_en: A stop command is active or/and a lock is active
fault_codes.summary_zh: 控制器偵測到 Stop command 1/2 或 Lock contact 處於啟動狀態，門可能被停止命令或鎖定條件禁止運行。
possible_causes: Emergency stop / stop button 被按下
Stop 1/2 接線端子仍為開路或接點狀態不正確
Lock contact 啟動
鎖接線或停止迴路接線錯誤
相關 shunt 在未接設備時被移除

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 確認所有急停 / stop button 是否被按下；若被按下，先確認安全再復位。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Check whether a stop button, emergency stop, or lock input is active.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 檢查 lock 是否處於鎖定狀態；確認門是否被機械鎖或電鎖阻止。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Inspect the stop/lock wiring and connectors for loose or damaged connections.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 查看 input/output display 的 B input，manual 將 B 對應 Fire detection / Stop command 1 or 2 / Lock contact。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Use the input/output display to identify which stop or lock input is ON.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 由合資格人員檢查 Stop 1/2 端子 18-16、18-19 以及 lock wiring。
guided_checks.instruction_en: If the input remains active, isolate the related device or terminal according to company SOP.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 若沒有接 stop 或 lock 裝置，確認對應 shunt 是否按照 wiring 要求保留。
guided_checks.instruction_en: After repair, confirm the stop and lock functions operate correctly before returning the door to service.

recommended_resolution: 復位急停 / stop button
解除或修復 lock contact 問題
修正 Stop 1/2 或 Lock 接線
恢復必要 shunt，或按規範接入安全接點

fault_codes.title_zh: 門偵測到阻力點 / 摩擦過大
fault_codes.title_en: Door detects hard spot or excessive friction
fault_codes.manual_meaning_en: The door detects hard spot or exceeding frictions
fault_codes.summary_zh: 門在運行時偵測到異常阻力、卡點或摩擦過大。此代碼應優先做機械檢查，而不是直接調參或更換電氣部件。
possible_causes: 門軌、地面或門路徑有異物
滑輪、導軌、吊輪或底部導向件卡住
門封、gasket 或 passive edge mount 摩擦過大
門體偏斜、機械調整不良
皮帶張力不合適或跳齒
低溫結霜造成摩擦增加

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 停止門動作，確認人員不要站在門運行路徑中。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Inspect the door track and travel path for ice, debris, bent parts, or obstruction.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 檢查門軌、地面、門框、門封位置是否有異物或結冰。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Move the door manually, if safe, and identify whether friction occurs at a fixed position.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 斷開自動運行條件後，手動推門，記錄是否順暢、是否有固定卡點。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Check gasket contact, belt condition, rollers, hinges, and door alignment.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 檢查滑輪、導軌、belt guide、gasket、門封是否磨損、變形或卡住。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Confirm the door is not being forced against a mechanical end stop.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 拍攝卡阻位置或異常摩擦位置。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Measure motor current if excessive friction or overload is suspected.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 清除異物或調整機械後，重新測試門開關。若仍異常，升級檢查 motor blocking / encoder / belt。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Correct the mechanical issue and test several full open/close cycles.

recommended_resolution: 清除障礙物或冰霜
調整門體、滑輪、導軌或門封
檢查並修正 belt tension / belt guide
必要時執行 initialization process

fault_codes.title_zh: 馬達阻塞 / 門太重難以開啟
fault_codes.title_en: Motor blocking / door too hard to open
fault_codes.manual_meaning_en: The door detects motor blocking / door too hard to open
fault_codes.summary_zh: 控制器偵測到馬達阻塞或門阻力過大到難以開啟。需先排除機械卡阻，再檢查 motor cable、encoder cable、電源與 motor 狀態。
possible_causes: 門被卡住或負載過重
門機械調整不良，手動也難以移動
motor cable 未插好或損壞
encoder cable 未插好或損壞
供電問題或 circuit breaker 問題
馬達或減速機故障

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 先確認門路徑安全，不要強行反覆啟動馬達。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Stop operation and confirm the door area is safe.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 手動測試門是否可順暢移動；若很重或卡住，先處理機械問題。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Check whether the door is blocked, frozen, mechanically jammed, or too heavy to move.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 檢查 motor cable 與 encoder cable 是否正確插入 command box。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Inspect motor wiring, belt, transmission parts, and mechanical drive components.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 由合資格人員檢查 power supply、circuit breaker 與供電端。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Manually move the door only if it is safe and permitted by SOP.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 需要時用鉗形錶量 motor current，判斷是否過載或堵轉。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Use a clamp meter or multimeter as required to check for overload or electrical fault.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 若要拔除 motor cable，必須先切斷 power supply。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Repair the mechanical or motor issue before resetting and testing the controller.

recommended_resolution: 排除門卡阻或過重問題
重新固定 motor / encoder connector
恢復正常供電與 circuit breaker 狀態
若馬達或減速機異常，交由合資格人員檢修或更換

fault_codes.title_zh: 鎖啟動狀態下偵測到手動開門嘗試
fault_codes.title_en: Manual opening attempt with lock active
fault_codes.manual_meaning_en: The door detects manual opening attempt with LOCK = 1 or with an active lock
fault_codes.summary_zh: 門在 LOCK=1 或鎖接點啟動時偵測到手動開門嘗試。需要先確認 lock 狀態、門是否被人為推動，以及鎖機構是否正常。
possible_causes: 有人在鎖定狀態下嘗試手動推門
Lock input 被啟動
鎖機構或鎖接點誤動作
LOCK parameter 設定不符合現場使用方式

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 確認是否有人在門被鎖定時嘗試手動開門。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Check whether someone attempted to open the door manually while the lock was active.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 檢查 lock contact 是否仍啟動，必要時查看 LOCK 狀態。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Inspect the lock and manual release condition.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 檢查鎖機構是否卡住、未完全釋放或接點異常。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Confirm the door is not mechanically forced against the lock.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 確認 LOCK function 是否為現場需要的設定。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Reset according to the controller procedure only after confirming the lock and door are safe.

recommended_resolution: 解除鎖定狀態後再操作門
修復 lock contact 或鎖機構
重新檢查 LOCK parameter 與接線

fault_codes.summary_zh: 控制器偵測到 Fire detection input 啟動。此類狀態應先確認是否為真實消防信號，不應直接旁路或清除。
possible_causes: 消防系統真實啟動
Fire detection 接點被觸發
Fire detection wiring 或 shunt 狀態異常
火警輸入接點故障

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 先確認現場是否存在火警、煙霧或消防系統動作。若有，按照消防程序處理。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Treat the fire input as high priority and check the site fire system status.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 查看 input/output display 的 B input 狀態，B 對應 Fire detection / Stop command / Lock contact。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Confirm whether the fire alarm or fire input is actually active.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 由合資格人員檢查 fire detection wiring，manual 標示此為 hold-on contact，安裝時需移除對應 shunt。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Inspect the fire input wiring and interface relay if the alarm is not active.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 確認火警信號解除後再進行門系統測試。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Do not bypass the fire input unless authorized by site safety procedure.

recommended_resolution: 若為真實消防信號，按消防 / 建築安全程序處理
若為誤信號，檢查 fire detection 接點與接線
恢復正確 shunt / hold-on contact 配置

fault_codes.title_zh: 安全裝置啟動、測試中或故障
fault_codes.title_en: Safety device active, testing, or out of order
fault_codes.manual_meaning_en: One safety device at least is active or testing in progress or out of order
fault_codes.summary_zh: 至少一個 safety device 啟動、測試中或故障。常見方向包括水平光電、vertical safety、edgemount、安全輸入接線或對位問題。
possible_causes: Fotocell / horizontal safety device 被遮擋
光電反射器未對準
Safety sensor power supply 異常
安全輸入接線錯誤或 shunt 移除 / 保留不正確
Vertical safety 或 edgemount 故障
低溫或水氣造成 sensor 污染

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 檢查門口安全光線是否被人、貨物、冰霜或異物遮擋。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Check whether any safety device is blocked, triggered, being tested, or out of order.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 檢查 H1 sensor 的 GREEN POWER SUPPLY OK 與 ORANGE ALIGNMENT OK / SIGNAL OK 指示。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Inspect photo cells, safety edge, light curtain, sensor alignment, and safety wiring.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 檢查光電與反射器是否按照 opening side 對位，紅點/beam 是否在中心。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Use the input/output display to identify the active safety input.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 查看 input/output display 的 optical safety / edgemount input 狀態。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Check sensor LEDs and wiring continuity according to the manual.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 由合資格人員檢查 safety device wiring 與 remove shunt 是否符合安裝方式。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Do not permanently bypass the safety device.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 若安全裝置故障超過 30 秒，manual 提到可用 press-and-hold command 關門；此操作只應作為受控應急動作，且不得永久旁路安全裝置。
guided_checks.instruction_en: After correction, test the safety function before returning the door to service.

recommended_resolution: 清除遮擋或冰霜
重新對準光電 sensor / reflector
修復 sensor 供電、接線或 safety input
檢查 vertical safety / edgemount 狀態
修復後測試安全功能

fault_codes.manual_meaning_en: Door position is lost after 5 attempts due to belt skipping, blocked door or internal malfunction of control unit
fault_codes.summary_zh: 控制器在多次嘗試後無法識別門位置。常見方向是皮帶跳齒、門被卡住、encoder 問題、或控制器內部異常。
possible_causes: 皮帶跳齒或張力不良
門被障礙物或機械問題卡住
Encoder cover 未裝好或損壞
Encoder connector 未插好
Encoder cable 被夾傷或損壞
控制器內部異常

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 檢查門是否被卡住；手動推動確認是否能順暢移動。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Check whether the controller lost the door position after power loss, belt movement, or encoder issue.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 檢查 belt 是否鬆脫、跳齒、磨損或張力不足。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Inspect encoder, belt, motor connection, and position feedback wiring.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 檢查 encoder cover 是否在 motor reducer 上，且沒有損壞。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Confirm the door can move safely in manual/deadman mode if required.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 檢查 encoder connector 是否正確連接在 command box 下方。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Reprogram end positions according to the manual.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 檢查 encoder cable 是否被夾傷、壓傷或損壞。
guided_checks.instruction_en: Run full open/close cycles and confirm the position display is stable.

guided_checks.instruction_zh: 清除機械問題後，必要時執行 initialization process。
guided_checks.instruction_en: If the fault repeats, inspect or replace the encoder/position feedback components.

recommended_resolution: 排除門卡住問題
重新調整或更換皮帶
修復 encoder cover / connector / cable
執行 initialization process
若仍反覆丟失位置，檢查控制器

tools.purpose_zh: 讀取 OK、moving door、open door、timer countdown、information codes、C1-C8、input/output display。
tools.safety_zh: 不要直接按壓 display 面板；按鍵操作需根據 manual 順序。
tools.purpose_en: Read OK, moving door, open door, timer countdown, information codes, C1-C8, and input/output display.
tools.safety_en: Do not press directly on the display panel. Follow the manual sequence for key operation.

tools.purpose_zh: 檢查門軌、門路徑、門封、gasket、belt、sensor alignment、connector、接線、指示燈狀態。
tools.safety_zh: 檢查時避免站在門運行範圍內；涉及控制箱內部需合資格人員。
tools.purpose_en: Check tracks, door path, gasket, belt, sensor alignment, connectors, wiring, and indicator LEDs.
tools.safety_en: Stay out of the door travel path. Internal control-box inspection must be done by qualified personnel.

tools.purpose_zh: 判斷門是否順暢、偏重、固定位置卡住、或完全不能移動。
tools.safety_zh: 測試前確認門不會自動啟動；必要時隔離自動運行條件。
tools.purpose_en: Check whether the door moves smoothly, is heavy, jams at a fixed position, or cannot move.
tools.safety_en: Confirm the door cannot start automatically before testing. Isolate automatic operation if needed.

tools.purpose_zh: 檢查電源、24Vcc 供電、stop/lock/fire/safety/opening input 狀態與接點是否短路。
tools.safety_zh: 帶電測量只限合資格人員；確認檔位與測點；不得隨意旁路 safety input。
tools.purpose_en: Check power supply, 24V DC, stop/lock/fire/safety/opening inputs, and possible short circuits.
tools.safety_en: Live measurements must be performed only by qualified personnel. Confirm range and test points before measuring.

tools.purpose_zh: 檢查 motor current 是否異常，輔助判斷 motor blocking、過載或機械阻力過高。
tools.safety_zh: 帶電測量只限合資格人員，保持安全距離。
tools.purpose_en: Check motor current to help identify blocking, overload, or excessive mechanical friction.
tools.safety_en: Live current measurement must be done only by qualified personnel while keeping a safe distance.

tools.purpose_zh: 拍攝 display code、sensor LED、接線端子、卡阻位置、維修前後狀態。
tools.safety_zh: 拍照時不要進入門運行路徑；不要為拍照而打開帶電控制箱。
tools.purpose_en: Take photos of display codes, sensor LEDs, terminals, jammed positions, and before/after repair condition.
tools.safety_en: Do not enter the door travel path for a photo. Do not open a live control box just to take a photo.

safety_notes.content_zh: 電氣接線、控制箱內測量、馬達/encoder 接頭檢查、帶電測量及安全裝置迴路檢查，應由合資格技術人員根據當地法規與公司 SOP 執行。
safety_notes.content_en: Electrical wiring, internal control-box measurements, motor/encoder connector checks, live measurements, and safety circuit checks must be performed by qualified technicians following local regulations and company SOP.

safety_notes.title_zh: 拔除馬達前必須切斷電源
safety_notes.content_zh: manual 明確要求：disconnecting motor 前必須先切斷 power supply。
safety_notes.title_en: Disconnect power before unplugging the motor
safety_notes.content_en: The manual requires the power supply to be disconnected before disconnecting the motor.

safety_notes.title_zh: 不得永久旁路安全裝置
safety_notes.content_zh: 安全裝置 active/testing/fault 時，應檢查 sensor、alignment、wiring 與 shunt；不得為恢復運行而永久旁路 safety device。
safety_notes.title_en: Do not permanently bypass safety devices
safety_notes.content_en: When a safety device is active, being tested, or faulty, inspect the sensor, alignment, wiring, and shunt. Do not permanently bypass safety devices to restore operation.

safety_notes.content_zh: manual 指出供電為 220-240V AC 50/60Hz，連接電纜 3G2.5mm²，且每個 kit 應連接到 dedicated power line，並由 D curve circuit breaker 保護。
safety_notes.content_en: The manual specifies 220-240V AC 50/60Hz, 3G2.5mm2 cable, a dedicated power line for each kit, and D-curve circuit breaker protection.

safety_notes.content_zh: 環境溫度低於 -10°C 時，需要 low temperature command box；不應使用標準控制箱替代。
safety_notes.content_en: When ambient temperature is below -10C, a low-temperature command box is required. Do not substitute a standard control box.

safety_notes.content_zh: manual 說明 integrated lock does not replace the use of a mechanical lock。
safety_notes.title_en: Integrated lock is not a mechanical lock replacement
safety_notes.content_en: The manual states that the integrated lock does not replace a mechanical lock.

inputs.designation_zh: Fire detection / Stop command 1 or 2 / Lock contact
inputs.designation_en: Fire detection / Stop command 1 or 2 / Lock contact

outputs.designation_zh: Motor working command and flashing lights
outputs.designation_en: Motor working command and flashing lights

initialization_guide.title_zh: 初始化 / 重新學習流程
use_when: 門位置丟失後排除障礙
門被卡住多次後需要重置
清除機械障礙或調整 belt 後需要重新學習位置
steps: 等待 initialization 完成或確認目前狀態可操作。
檢查 C8 = 00000；若需要重新學習，將 parameter C8 設為 0。
同時按住控制鍵盤 4 個按鈕約 3 秒，然後放開；應出現 initialization display。
發出 full opening command，例如 push-button / badge 等。
等待門重新設定開關方向與位置。
門停止在 closed position 並顯示 OK，表示完成。
preconditions: 安全裝置已接好或正確 shunt
第一次 opening command 前應手動關門，以避免開門方向學習錯誤

checks_zh: 檢查 belt guide
清除門路徑障礙物
清除後執行 initialization process

likely_causes_zh: 正常現象：關門速度低於開門速度
checks_zh: 檢查 vertical security
檢查門摩擦與卡阻
確認是否只是正常關門速度設定

likely_causes_zh: motor cable 或 encoder cable 未插入 command box
checks_zh: 檢查 motor cable 與 encoder cable
檢查 power supply
檢查 stop buttons
門停止時發出 opening command 嘗試打開
5 次失敗後系統會開始 initialization cycle reset
清除任何障礙物

likely_causes_zh: 關閉側 safety / edgemount 狀態
checks_zh: 5 次自動關閉失敗後門會停止
清除障礙物
發出 opening command 讓系統開始 initialization cycle reset

likely_causes_zh: 首次上電前門未手動關閉
checks_zh: 將 C8 設為 0
手動關門
按住 4 個按鈕 3 秒
發出 opening command
